name: Brâncuși Monumental Ensemble of Târgu Jiu
description: In the Romanian city of Târgu Jiu, Constantin Brâncuși lined up three abstract sculptures along a 1.3-kilometre east–west axis in 1937–1938. Visitors pass the Table of Silence and the Gate of the Kiss, then reach the towering Endless Column. Together they honour local soldiers who died defending the city in the First World War, and they link two parks and a church.
